api.name: ProducerTemplate
api.title: Producer Template
api.description: Sends messages to endpoints from code outside a route: context.createProducerTemplate(), or injected (@Produce, @Autowired). One instance created once and reused, it is a started service. sendBody is InOnly (no reply), requestBody is InOut and returns the reply; a failure comes back as CamelExecutionException with the cause.

asyncSendBody.description: Sends without blocking; asyncRequestBody(uri, body) returns a CompletableFuture of the reply.
